note.explanation: Network security protects data and helps prevent unauthorized access. Your textbook describes three methods: firewalls monitor and control network traffic, encryption converts data into a secure format, and antivirus software detects and removes malicious software.
note.checkAnswer: Encryption converts data into a secure format.
note.simple: A firewall checks network traffic, encryption scrambles data into a secure format, and antivirus software finds and removes harmful software.
note.checkQuestion: What does encryption do to data?
note.title: Network security methods
steps: Firewall: Monitor and control incoming and outgoing network traffic.
Encryption: Protects data by converting it into a secure format.
Antivirus software: Detects and removes malicious software.
Example: A combination of firewalls, encryption, and antivirus software provides robust network security.
note.answer: Firewalls, encryption, and antivirus software work together to provide robust network security.

examTips: A short question may ask you to explain encryption or state how a firewall contributes to network security. Give the method's function clearly.
A long question may ask you to evaluate several security methods. Explain the function of each method, then conclude how using them together helps protect a network.
For full marks, do not mix up the three functions: firewalls monitor and control traffic, encryption converts data into a secure format, and antivirus software detects and removes malicious software.

explain.title: Firewalls
explain.body: Monitor and control incoming and outgoing network traffic. A firewall helps manage what traffic enters or leaves a network.

explain.title: Encryption
explain.body: Protects data by converting it into a secure format. This changes the data so it is not in its ordinary readable form.

explain.title: Antivirus software
explain.body: Detects and removes malicious software. This helps protect devices and networks from harmful programs.

explain.title: Use methods together
explain.body: Your textbook's example says that a combination of firewalls, encryption, and antivirus software provides robust network security.

mistakes: Do not say that a firewall encrypts data; its stated job is to monitor and control network traffic.
Do not say that encryption detects viruses; antivirus software detects and removes malicious software.
Do not list only the names of the methods in a long answer. Explain what each one does.
Do not confuse the secure format produced by encryption with the removal of malicious software by antivirus software.
